title: Red Happy Bolton's death
summary: Red Happy left New Orleans hoping King Oliver would hire him, and was later found beaten, reportedly killed in Cleveland.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians
